Context: 15. Extra Work Allowance

## 15. Extra Work Allowance  
E  
Caretaking Allowance, Extra Duty Allowance, Flag Station Allowance, Flight Charge Certificate Allowance, Library Allowance, Rajbhasha Allowance and Special Appointment Allowance stand abolished and eligible employees will be covered under a new "Extra Work Allowance":-  
- (a) Extra Work Allowance will be paid at a uniform rate of 2% of Basic Pay per month.
